title: Breaking the AWS MCP Python Sandbox
description: A security researcher discovered a method to bypass the AWS MCP Python sandbox restrictions in the aws___run_script tool, which executes user-supplied Python code in a restricted AWS Lambda environment. The sandbox uses AST validation and runtime proxy objects to block dangerous operations, including attribute access and imports. However, the researcher found that Python's structural pattern matching (match/case) can implicitly read attributes listed in __match_args__, bypassing the sandbox's attribute access restrictions. By assigning __match_args__ to sensitive dunder attributes and constructing attribute names at runtime, the researcher achieved sandbox escape and system command execution within the Lambda environment.
